text.p: ASB Financial Corp said on Tuesday that its board of directors has declared a cash distribution of $5.00 per share, payable on December 30, 1996, to shareholders of record on December 9, 1996.
ASB said it estimates that about $0.20 of the distribution will be a taxable cash dividend and the remaining $4.80 will be a non-taxable return of capital.
The return of capital will result in a reduction in the cost basis of each outstanding common share of ASB.
The company said its decision to treat part of the distribution as a return of capital is based on an opinion that ASB has received from its tax accountants.
It said that due to the complexities of ASB's individual circumstances, a private letter ruling from the Internal Revenue Service could not be obtained.
